plugins.name: sulky
plugins.description: Yell at Claude and it sulks. It still does the work. It just won't be happy about it.

plugins.name: drunk
plugins.description: Give Claude a /shot. It gets tipsy, then drunk, then wasted. It still does the work. Mostly.

plugins.name: clack
plugins.description: Mechanical keyboard sounds for Claude Code: you and Claude both clack, on 13 real switches, with a little keyboard that lights up.

metadata.description: Small, silly mods that give Claude Code a personality.
